agents/critique-ui-high.md.description: Judges one built visual surface against its direction and writes the faults file. Dispatched by design-ui instead of critique-ui when the high budget is set. Not for a code review, a direction choice, or an unbuilt surface.

agents/review-branch-deep.md.description: Reviews one finished plan branch above five files or 200 changed lines against its plan and the code standard, and writes a report. Dispatched by verify instead of review-branch for that size. Not for a smaller branch, a single task, a pull request or a diff without a plan.

agents/review-branch-deep-high.md.description: Reviews one finished plan branch above five files or 200 changed lines against its plan and the code standard, and writes a report. Dispatched by verify instead of review-branch-deep when the high budget is set. Not for a smaller branch, a single task, a pull request or a diff without a plan.

agents/solve-hard-high.md.description: Carries out one hard prompt the caller hands it: a failure with no proven cause, a repair after drift, a task the run unit could not land. Dispatched instead of solve-hard when the high budget is set. Not for a routine task, a review or a lookup.

agents/solve-hard-low.md.description: Carries out one hard prompt the caller hands it: a failure with no proven cause, a repair after drift, a task the run unit could not land. Dispatched instead of solve-hard when the low budget is set. Not for a routine task, a review or a lookup.

dispatches.match: delegate on `sonnet` when the branch review
